name: Records unreadable at a glance
problem: An intent's folder of CSV files states it completely, but a person clicking into it cannot tell at a glance what the intent is for, how its solutions fit or where to go next: that takes opening several files and following ids between them.
who_has_it: Newcomers, reviewers and AI agents who open an intent's folder or click through the folders of a repository that applies ESOI.
why_it_matters: Records that take several files and many ids to read are reviewed less often, so mistakes in them last longer, and hand-written summaries beside them repeat the records and drift from them.
why_hard: A readable page has to agree with the records at all times, so it cannot be kept by hand; the records can be long (one repository holds hundreds of rows in one intent) and in an order that differs from what a reader needs first; a page that summarizes must not hide a record; and a person's own prose about the network is theirs and has to stay.
existing_attempts: A README per folder written by hand; a page that lists the record tables in file order; a separate diagram page; spreadsheets for review; generated indexes of components.
